## Core Principles

Our commitment to responsible AI development

Transparency

Open AI Operations

Sprinto provides clear disclosure of AI subprocessors, models used, and how AI is applied across compliance workflows. AI feature development follows a deliberate data hierarchy: publicly available data is the first preference, followed by Sprinto's own internal IP and knowledge base, and customer data is used only to validate (never train) AI outputs when internal data is insufficient. The AI Trust Center maintains a live, verifiable compliance posture at all times.

Privacy by Design

AI built with privacy in mind

Privacy and security controls are integrated directly into the AI development lifecycle. Customer data — including personal data — is never used to train AI models. All AI vendors are contractually bound to a fixed deletion policy (data permanently deleted after 30–60 days) and a legally binding data usage agreement prohibiting model training on Sprinto-provided data. Only data appropriate to a specific use case is ever accessed.

Accountability & User Control

Humans stay in command

AI features are designed to assist and guide human decision-making — not replace it. In the Security Questionnaire, AI generates responses, but users have the final authority to accept or decline. Policy recommendations are suggestions only. Users can review, edit, ignore, and provide feedback on any AI output, and AI features can be disabled at any time via the settings page. Internally, Sprinto maintains clearly defined roles and a dedicated team for ongoing AI development, oversight, and monitoring.
